Based on my examination of your project files, here are 20 paragraphs of deep reflection on how this type system should be architected:
Deep Reflection on the Type System Architecture
The Core Philosophy of Representatives: The representative pattern you've sketched embodies the same "artful invisibility" that permeates $Chemistry - these aren't mere wrapper objects but rather semantic lenses through which JavaScript's prototypal chaos becomes comprehensible. Each representative class serves as a stable interface to fundamentally unstable runtime values, creating a type-safe bridge between compile-time TypeScript reasoning and runtime JavaScript reality. The key insight is that representatives must be immutable proxies - they observe but never mutate their underlying literals, allowing the same object to be examined through multiple representative lenses simultaneously without interference.
Lazy Evaluation Through Private Caching: Following your # variable pattern from $Chemistry, each representative should maintain a private cache for expensive conversions. When $ObjectRepresentative.asPrototype is called, it shouldn't immediately construct a new $PrototypeRepresentative - instead it should check #prototype, compute and cache if absent, then return. This pattern must be consistent across all inter-representative getters. The cache invalidation strategy is trivial here because representatives are immutable - if you need a different representative, construct a new one rather than mutating an existing cache. This aligns with your philosophy that proper abstractions throw errors rather than silently handle edge cases.
The Circular Reference Topology: The most fascinating aspect of your sketch is the circular web of conversions - objects become prototypes become objects, functions become constructors become functions, primitives become objects that could theoretically wrap back to primitives through valueOf. This isn't a design flaw but rather an accurate reflection of JavaScript's prototypal nature. The implementation must embrace these cycles through lazy evaluation rather than attempting to resolve them eagerly. When $FunctionRepresentative.$asObject is called, it returns an $ObjectRepresentative that lazily points back through asPrototype to the function's prototype, creating a stable cycle without infinite recursion.
Constructor Signature Patterns: Every representative needs exactly one constructor parameter - the literal value it represents. No parent parameters, no dependency injection complexity. The pattern should be: constructor(literal: T) where T is the specific type this representative wraps. Validation happens in the constructor - if you pass a non-function to $FunctionRepresentative, it throws immediately with a clear message. This follows your principle of assuming correct usage while failing loudly on violations, exactly like how $Chemical throws when bonds are malformed rather than attempting recovery.
The Role-Based Type Hierarchy: Your note about "role-based" typing is crucial. These aren't classical inheritance hierarchies where $MethodRepresentative "is-a" specialized $MemberRepresentative in behavior - rather, they're discriminated unions where each role exposes different facets of the same underlying PropertyDescriptor. The$isField, $isProperty, $isMethod pattern creates a TypeScript-friendly type guard system that narrows at compile time while maintaining runtime flexibility. This mirrors how $Particle and $Chemical represent different roles for the same object graph rather than strict inheritance.
Member Discrimination Logic: The discrimination between field, property, and method representatives must be deterministic and based solely on the PropertyDescriptor structure. A field is descriptor.value !== undefined && typeof descriptor.value !== 'function'. A property is descriptor.get || descriptor.set. A method is descriptor.value && typeof descriptor.value === 'function'. These are mutually exclusive by design, though a descriptor could theoretically be none of them (a raw descriptor with only configurable/enumerable), in which case $MemberRepresentative returns undefined for all three $as* conversions.
Function Form Detection: The form getter on $FunctionRepresentative is where real sophistication enters. Distinguishing 'lambda' from 'function' requires checking whether the function has a prototype property that's extensible. 'method' means it's part of a class prototype chain. 'getter'/'setter' would only apply if this function was extracted from a descriptor. 'class' means toString() starts with 'class'. 'unknown' is the fallback. This analysis should be cached on first access in a#form variable, as stringifying functions and walking prototype chains is expensive.
The Type-Prototype Duality: $TypeRepresentative and $PrototypeRepresentative represent the same underlying object but with different semantic intent - one views it as a constructor's nature, the other as an instance's ancestry. They must be separate classes because their getter APIs serve different purposes. $TypeRepresentative exposes $members(), $fields(), etc., which walk the prototype chain gathering descriptors. $PrototypeRepresentative exposes asObject, which reifies the prototype as if it were an instance. This distinction is fundamental to understanding JavaScript's dual nature.
Member Enumeration Strategy: The $members(own) method family must use Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors() when own=true, but when own=false it needs to walk the entire prototype chain up to Object.prototype, collecting unique property names and their descriptors. The challenge is handling shadowing correctly - child descriptors override parent descriptors for the same property name. Store results in a Map<string, PropertyDescriptor> where later entries don't overwrite earlier ones, then construct representatives from the map values.
Parameter and Return Type Patterns: Every getter that crosses representative boundaries returns a new representative instance - this is crucial. $ObjectRepresentative.asPrototype doesn't return a cached prototype object; it returns new $PrototypeRepresentative(Object.getPrototypeOf(this.$literal)). This ensures immutability and thread-safety (though JavaScript is single-threaded, the principle matters for reasoning). The exception is when the conversion would be meaningless - $PrimitiveRepresentative.asObject on null should return undefined, not throw.
Literal Getter Semantics: Every representative exposes its underlying value through $literal, following your $ prefix convention for "framework-internal but exposed" APIs. This isn't a copy or clone - it's the exact reference passed to the constructor. For $PrimitiveRepresentative.$literal, this means returning the primitive value directly. For $FunctionRepresentative.$literal, it's the function reference. This creates a subtle power - representatives are immutable wrappers, but their literals remain fully mutable, allowing external code to modify objects while the representative continues to observe the changes.
The Constructor-Function Asymmetry: $FunctionRepresentative and $ConstructorRepresentative must be distinct because not all functions are constructors (arrow functions, async functions) and not all constructors should be called as functions (classes throw when called without new). The conversion $FunctionRepresentative.$asConstructor should only succeed when fn.prototype !== undefined - otherwise return undefined. Conversely, $ConstructorRepresentative.$asFunction always succeeds because every constructor is technically a function, even if calling it wrongly throws at runtime.
Async and Generator Detection: The async and generator getters on $FunctionRepresentative should check the constructor name: this.$literal.constructor.name === 'AsyncFunction' and this.$literal.constructor.name === 'GeneratorFunction'. These are cached in #async and #generator respectively. The native getter checks if toString() contains [native code]. None of these require walking prototype chains or heavy introspection, making them suitable for getters rather than methods.
Parameter Analysis Strategy: The params getter must parse the function's toString() representation, extracting everything between the first ( and matching ). This is fragile but unavoidable - JavaScript provides no reflection API for parameter counts on already-defined functions. The regex pattern should handle arrow functions ((...) =>), regular functions (function f(...)), and methods (f(...)). Destructuring parameters count as one parameter. Rest parameters set rest: true. Cache the result in #params since string parsing is expensive.
Base Type Chain Walking: $TypeRepresentative.$baseType returns another $TypeRepresentative wrapping the constructor's prototype's constructor - effectively walking up the class hierarchy. This getter must handle the chain termination correctly: when you reach Function or Object, return undefined rather than wrapping further. The implementation is const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(this.$literal.prototype); return proto?.constructor ? new $TypeRepresentative(proto.constructor) : undefined. Cache in #baseType since prototype walks are common.
Method Representative Conversion: $MethodRepresentative.$asFunction must extract the actual function from the PropertyDescriptor and wrap it in $FunctionRepresentative. If the descriptor is {value: someFunction}, this is straightforward: return new $FunctionRepresentative(this.$literal.value). This creates a clean separation between "function as method" (bound to an object) and "function as callable" (standalone), even though they're the same underlying function reference.
The Problem of $Type Literal: $TypeRepresentative.$literal returning $Type (which is $Constructor<T>) creates a subtle TypeScript issue - the generic T can't be preserved through the representative without making $TypeRepresentative itself generic, which breaks the uniform interface. The solution is to embrace type erasure: $TypeRepresentative is not generic, and its $literal returns $Constructor<any>. Users who need type preservation must maintain that context externally. This is an acceptable tradeoff for API simplicity.
Prototype vs Object Semantics: When $PrototypeRepresentative.asObject returns an $ObjectRepresentative, it's performing a semantic shift from "this is a prototype blueprint" to "this is an instance object." The underlying literal is the same, but the API contract changes. $ObjectRepresentative might expose instance-oriented operations, while $PrototypeRepresentative exposes inheritance-oriented operations. In practice, they might share much implementation, but the semantic distinction guides API design.
Edge Cases and Null Handling: Throughout the system, conversions that don't make sense return undefined rather than throwing. $PrimitiveRepresentative(null).asObject returns undefined because null has no object representation despite technically being a primitive. Similarly, $FunctionRepresentative for an arrow function's $asConstructor returns undefined rather than a representative of an invalid constructor. This follows the TypeScript pattern of usingundefined to signal "this operation doesn't apply" while throwing errors for "you used this operation wrong."
Integration with $Chemistry Philosophy: This type system should feel like a natural extension of $Chemistry's particle/chemical duality. Where $Particle represents minimal React-renderable objects, these representatives handle minimal JavaScript-introspectable values. The lazy evaluation pattern mirrors how $Chemical defers bond construction until rendering. The role-based discrimination mirrors how $Component and $$Component represent bound vs unbound states. And the circular reference topology mirrors how chemicals can contain themselves through parent-child relationships without infinite loops. The entire system becomes a fractal reflection of JavaScript's prototypal nature, viewed through the lens of your semantic reference theory.

I'll describe the implementation approach for each class conceptually:
$ObjectRepresentative
Stores the literal object reference in the constructor. The reference getter generates a stable string identifier - likely using a WeakMap to assign unique numeric IDs to objects since object identity matters for the catalogue system. Private caches: #prototype, #type, #members, #fields, #properties, #methods.
The $prototype getter checks #prototype, and if absent, calls Object.getPrototypeOf(this.$literal) and wraps it in a new $PrototypeRepresentative, caches it, returns it. asPrototype is identical.
The $type getter checks #type, creates new $TypeRepresentative(this.$literal.constructor) if needed.
Member enumeration methods check their respective caches. When computing, they use Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(this.$literal) for own=true. For own=false, they walk up the prototype chain, collecting all descriptors into a Map keyed by property name (earlier entries shadow later ones), then filter and wrap each descriptor in the appropriate representative subclass based on descriptor structure.
$PrototypeRepresentative
Nearly identical to $ObjectRepresentative in structure - same member enumeration pattern. The key difference is asObject creates an $ObjectRepresentative wrapping the same literal - this is a pure semantic shift without changing the underlying reference. The reference follows the same pattern as ObjectRepresentative since prototypes are objects.
$PrimitiveRepresentative
Stores the primitive value directly. The reference getter likely returns the primitive's string representation, possibly with type prefix to distinguish "5" (string) from 5 (number).
The asObject getter checks if the literal is null or undefined and returns undefined in those cases. Otherwise, it wraps using Object(this.$literal) which creates a boxed wrapper (Number, String, Boolean object), then wraps that in $ObjectRepresentative. Cache in #object.
$FunctionRepresentative
Stores the function reference. The reference uses the same object identity pattern as ObjectRepresentative since functions are objects.
The $asConstructor getter checks #constructor. It examines whether this.$literal.prototype !== undefined (arrow functions lack this). If true, wraps in new $ConstructorRepresentative(this.$literal). If false, returns undefined.
The $asObject getter treats the function as an object, wrapping it in $ObjectRepresentative.
For the function analysis getters (form, name, etc.), call parseFunctionInfo(this.$literal) once and cache the entire result object in #info. Then each getter pulls from that cached info object. This ensures the expensive string parsing only happens once.
$ConstructorRepresentative
Stores the constructor function. The reference mirrors function/object identity patterns.
The $asFunction getter checks #function, creates new $FunctionRepresentative(this.$literal), caches and returns. This is always valid because every constructor is a function, even if it shouldn't be called without new.
$TypeRepresentative
Stores the constructor. The reference could use constructor name plus identity, since types are about the constructor's role.
The $baseType getter checks #baseType. Gets Object.getPrototypeOf(this.$literal.prototype)?.constructor. If that exists and isn't Function or Object, wraps it in new $TypeRepresentative(...). Otherwise returns undefined.
The $prototype getter wraps this.$literal.prototype in $PrototypeRepresentative.
The $asConstructor simply wraps this.$literal in $ConstructorRepresentative.
Member enumeration is identical to $ObjectRepresentative but operates on this.$literal.prototype instead of this.$literal directly. This walks the class hierarchy collecting all inherited members.
$MemberRepresentative
Base class stores literal: PropertyDescriptor and optionally name: string (needed for debugging/reference). The reference could be based on the property name if provided, or a hash of the descriptor structure.
The $isField getter checks this.$literal.value !== undefined && typeof this.$literal.value !== 'function'.
The $isProperty getter checks this.$literal.get !== undefined || this.$literal.set !== undefined.
The $isMethod getter checks this.$literal.value !== undefined && typeof this.$literal.value === 'function'.
The $asField getter calls this.$isField, and if true, returns new $FieldRepresentative(this.$literal, this.name). Otherwise undefined.
Similar pattern for $asProperty and $asMethod.
$FieldRepresentative / $PropertyRepresentative
These are simple - they override the base class getters to return true for their type check and this for their conversion. The constructor just passes through to the base class.
$MethodRepresentative
Same override pattern. Additionally has #function cache and $asFunction getter that checks cache, then extracts this.$literal.value (the actual function) and wraps it in new $FunctionRepresentative(this.$literal.value).
Key Implementation Patterns:
Reference Generation: Need a stable, catalogue-friendly string for each representative. Objects/functions use WeakMap-based identity. Primitives use string representation. Types use constructor name plus identity.
Lazy Evaluation: Every conversion getter checks its cache first. Compute on cache miss, store, return. Never recompute.
New Instances on Conversion: asX methods always create fresh representative instances, never return cached objects. This maintains immutability semantics.
Member Walking: Prototype chain traversal uses a while loop up to Object.prototype, collecting property names in a Set, then getting descriptors and wrapping them. The own parameter short-circuits this to just Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(target).
Type Discrimination: Based purely on descriptor shape. Mutually exclusive categories. No descriptor matches no category (all conversions return undefined).
Error Handling: Constructor validates type immediately. If wrong type passed, throw with clear message. Conversions that don't apply return undefined, not errors.

Ah yes, you're absolutely right! Let me redescribe with proper recursion:
The Lazy Property Pattern
Every class follows this pattern:
text
get $property(): Type {
    if (this.#property === undefined) {
        this.#property = /* compute value */;
    }
    return this.#property;
}
#property?: Type;
Every $ getter has a corresponding # field. Check undefined, compute once, cache forever.
Recursive Member Enumeration
$TypeRepresentative.$members(own=false):
If own=true: Get Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(this.$literal.prototype), wrap each, done.
If own=false:
Create a Set<string> to track seen property names
Get own descriptors from this.$literal.prototype
Add all property names to the Set
Get this.$baseType (another $TypeRepresentative or undefined)
If baseType exists, recursively call baseType.$members(false)
For each base member, only include it if its name is NOT in the Set (shadowing)
Return concatenated array: own members + non-shadowed base members
$ObjectRepresentative.$members(own=false):
If own=true: Get Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(this.$literal), wrap each, done.
If own=false:
Create a Set<string> for seen names
Get own descriptors from this.$literal
Add all property names to Set
Get this.$prototype (a $PrototypeRepresentative)
If prototype exists and isn't null, recursively call prototype.$members(false)
Filter base members by Set (shadowing)
Return own + non-shadowed base
$PrototypeRepresentative.$members(own=false):
Identical to $ObjectRepresentative since prototypes are objects
Recursion walks up the prototype chain naturally
Null and Undefined as Types
null and undefined get their own primitive representatives:
$PrimitiveRepresentative(null) - the null type
$PrimitiveRepresentative(undefined) - the undefined type
These terminate the recursion chains. When walking prototypes, eventually you hit Object.getPrototypeOf(something) === null, and that's where the chain ends.
Entry Points
$TypeRepresentative is the entry for class hierarchies:
You construct it with a constructor function
It knows how to get $baseType (the parent class)
It knows how to get $prototype (the instance shape)
From there, the cascade begins
$ObjectRepresentative is the entry for instances:
You construct it with any object instance
It knows how to get $prototype (its prototype chain)
It knows how to get $type (its constructor)
This connects instances to their class hierarchies
So the flow is:
text
Instance → $ObjectRepresentative
  → $prototype → $PrototypeRepresentative (recursively up chain)
  → $type → $TypeRepresentative (the class)
    → $baseType → $TypeRepresentative (parent class, recursively up hierarchy)
Does this capture the recursive, lazy, cascading nature you're describing?

typescript
import { $Type, $Constructor, $Rep } from "./types";

export interface $FunctionInfo {
    form: 'lambda' | 'function' | 'method' | 'getter' | 'setter' | 'class' | 'unknown';
    name?: string;
    async?: boolean;
    generator?: boolean;
    native?: boolean;
    params?: {
        count: number | undefined;
        rest: boolean | undefined;
    };
}

// Global WeakMap for object identity tracking
const objectIds = new WeakMap<object, number>();
let nextObjectId = 1;

function getObjectId(obj: object): number {
    let id = objectIds.get(obj);
    if (id === undefined) {
        id = nextObjectId++;
        objectIds.set(obj, id);
    }
    return id;
}

export class $ObjectRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: object;
    #ref?: string;
    #prototype?: $PrototypeRep;
    #type?: $TypeRep;
    #members?: Map<boolean, $MemberRep[]>;
    #fields?: Map<boolean, $FieldRep[]>;
    #properties?: Map<boolean, $PropertyRep[]>;
    #methods?: Map<boolean, $MethodRep[]>;

    constructor(literal: object) {
        if (typeof literal !== 'object' || literal === null) {
            throw new Error(`$ObjectRep requires object, got ${typeof literal}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal;
        this.#members = new Map();
        this.#fields = new Map();
        this.#properties = new Map();
        this.#methods = new Map();
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Object#${getObjectId(this.#literal)}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): object {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get $prototype(): $PrototypeRep {
        if (this.#prototype === undefined) {
            const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(this.#literal);
            if (proto === null) {
                this.#prototype = undefined as any; // Terminal case
            } else {
                this.#prototype = new $PrototypeRep(proto);
            }
        }
        return this.#prototype!;
    }

    get asPrototype(): $PrototypeRep {
        return this.$prototype;
    }

    get $type(): $TypeRep {
        if (this.#type === undefined) {
            const constructor = this.#literal.constructor;
            if (constructor && typeof constructor === 'function') {
                this.#type = new $TypeRep(constructor as $Constructor);
            } else {
                this.#type = undefined as any;
            }
        }
        return this.#type!;
    }

    $members(own: boolean = true): $MemberRep[] {
        const cached = this.#members!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result: $MemberRep[] = [];
        const seen = new Set<string>();

        // Get own descriptors
        const ownDescriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(this.#literal);
        for (const [name, desc] of Object.entries(ownDescriptors)) {
            seen.add(name);
            result.push(createMemberRep(desc, name));
        }

        // If not own-only, recurse through prototype chain
        if (!own) {
            const proto = this.$prototype;
            if (proto && proto.$literal !== null) {
                const baseMembers = proto.$members(false);
                for (const member of baseMembers) {
                    if (!seen.has((member as any).name)) {
                        result.push(member);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        this.#members!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $fields(own: boolean = true): $FieldRep[] {
        const cached = this.#fields!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const members = this.$members(own);
        const result = members
            .filter(m => m.$isField)
            .map(m => m.$asField!);

        this.#fields!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $properties(own: boolean = true): $PropertyRep[] {
        const cached = this.#properties!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const members = this.$members(own);
        const result = members
            .filter(m => m.$isProperty)
            .map(m => m.$asProperty!);

        this.#properties!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $methods(own: boolean = true): $MethodRep[] {
        const cached = this.#methods!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const members = this.$members(own);
        const result = members
            .filter(m => m.$isMethod)
            .map(m => m.$asMethod!);

        this.#methods!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $getField(name: string, own: boolean = true): $FieldRep | undefined {
        return this.$fields(own).find(f => (f as any).name === name);
    }

    $getProperty(name: string, own: boolean = true): $PropertyRep | undefined {
        return this.$properties(own).find(p => (p as any).name === name);
    }

    $getMethod(name: string, own: boolean = true): $MethodRep | undefined {
        return this.$methods(own).find(m => (m as any).name === name);
    }
}

export class $PrototypeRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: object;
    #ref?: string;
    #asObject?: $ObjectRep;
    #members?: Map<boolean, $MemberRep[]>;
    #fields?: Map<boolean, $FieldRep[]>;
    #properties?: Map<boolean, $PropertyRep[]>;
    #methods?: Map<boolean, $MethodRep[]>;

    constructor(literal: object) {
        if (typeof literal !== 'object' || literal === null) {
            throw new Error(`$PrototypeRep requires object, got ${typeof literal}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal;
        this.#members = new Map();
        this.#fields = new Map();
        this.#properties = new Map();
        this.#methods = new Map();
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Prototype#${getObjectId(this.#literal)}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): object {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get asObject(): $ObjectRep {
        if (this.#asObject === undefined) {
            this.#asObject = new $ObjectRep(this.#literal);
        }
        return this.#asObject;
    }

    $members(own: boolean = true): $MemberRep[] {
        const cached = this.#members!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result: $MemberRep[] = [];
        const seen = new Set<string>();

        // Get own descriptors
        const ownDescriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(this.#literal);
        for (const [name, desc] of Object.entries(ownDescriptors)) {
            seen.add(name);
            result.push(createMemberRep(desc, name));
        }

        // If not own-only, recurse up prototype chain
        if (!own) {
            const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(this.#literal);
            if (proto !== null) {
                const baseProto = new $PrototypeRep(proto);
                const baseMembers = baseProto.$members(false);
                for (const member of baseMembers) {
                    if (!seen.has((member as any).name)) {
                        result.push(member);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        this.#members!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $fields(own: boolean = true): $FieldRep[] {
        const cached = this.#fields!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const members = this.$members(own);
        const result = members
            .filter(m => m.$isField)
            .map(m => m.$asField!);

        this.#fields!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $properties(own: boolean = true): $PropertyRep[] {
        const cached = this.#properties!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const members = this.$members(own);
        const result = members
            .filter(m => m.$isProperty)
            .map(m => m.$asProperty!);

        this.#properties!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $methods(own: boolean = true): $MethodRep[] {
        const cached = this.#methods!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const members = this.$members(own);
        const result = members
            .filter(m => m.$isMethod)
            .map(m => m.$asMethod!);

        this.#methods!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $getField(name: string, own: boolean = true): $FieldRep | undefined {
        return this.$fields(own).find(f => (f as any).name === name);
    }

    $getProperty(name: string, own: boolean = true): $PropertyRep | undefined {
        return this.$properties(own).find(p => (p as any).name === name);
    }

    $getMethod(name: string, own: boolean = true): $MethodRep | undefined {
        return this.$methods(own).find(m => (m as any).name === name);
    }
}

export class $PrimitiveRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: any;
    #ref?: string;
    #asObject?: $ObjectRep;

    constructor(literal: any) {
        const type = typeof literal;
        if (type !== 'string' && type !== 'number' && type !== 'boolean' && 
            type !== 'undefined' && type !== 'symbol' && type !== 'bigint' && 
            literal !== null) {
            throw new Error(`$PrimitiveRep requires primitive, got ${type}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            const type = typeof this.#literal;
            if (this.#literal === null) {
                this.#ref = 'null';
            } else if (this.#literal === undefined) {
                this.#ref = 'undefined';
            } else {
                this.#ref = `${type}:${String(this.#literal)}`;
            }
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): any {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get asObject(): $ObjectRep {
        if (this.#asObject === undefined) {
            if (this.#literal === null || this.#literal === undefined) {
                return undefined as any;
            }
            // Box the primitive
            const boxed = Object(this.#literal);
            this.#asObject = new $ObjectRep(boxed);
        }
        return this.#asObject!;
    }
}

export class $FunctionRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: (...args: any[]) => any;
    #ref?: string;
    #asConstructor?: $ConstructorRep;
    #asObject?: $ObjectRep;
    #info?: $FunctionInfo;
    #typeParameters?: $TypeParameterRep[];
    #parameters?: $FunctionParameterRep[];
    #asGeneric?: $GenericFunctionRep;

    constructor(literal: Function) {
        if (typeof literal !== 'function') {
            throw new Error(`$FunctionRep requires function, got ${typeof literal}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal as any;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Function#${getObjectId(this.#literal)}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): (...args: any[]) => any {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get $asConstructor(): $ConstructorRep {
        if (this.#asConstructor === undefined) {
            // Check if function has prototype (not arrow function)
            if (this.#literal.prototype !== undefined) {
                this.#asConstructor = new $ConstructorRep(this.#literal);
            } else {
                return undefined as any;
            }
        }
        return this.#asConstructor!;
    }

    get $asObject(): $ObjectRep {
        if (this.#asObject === undefined) {
            this.#asObject = new $ObjectRep(this.#literal);
        }
        return this.#asObject;
    }

    get $isGeneric(): boolean {
        return this.$typeParameters.length > 0;
    }

    get $asGeneric(): $GenericFunctionRep {
        if (this.#asGeneric === undefined) {
            if (!this.$isGeneric) return undefined as any;
            this.#asGeneric = new $GenericFunctionRep(this);
        }
        return this.#asGeneric!;
    }

    get $typeParameters(): $TypeParameterRep[] {
        if (this.#typeParameters === undefined) {
            // Runtime JavaScript has no generic info - return empty array
            this.#typeParameters = [];
        }
        return this.#typeParameters;
    }

    #getInfo(): $FunctionInfo {
        if (this.#info === undefined) {
            this.#info = parseFunctionInfo(this.#literal);
        }
        return this.#info;
    }

    get form(): 'lambda' | 'function' | 'method' | 'getter' | 'setter' | 'class' | 'unknown' {
        return this.#getInfo().form;
    }

    get name(): string {
        return this.#getInfo().name || '';
    }

    get async(): boolean {
        return this.#getInfo().async || false;
    }

    get generator(): boolean {
        return this.#getInfo().generator || false;
    }

    get native(): boolean {
        return this.#getInfo().native || false;
    }

    get parameters(): $FunctionParameterRep[] {
        if (this.#parameters === undefined) {
            const info = this.#getInfo();
            const params = info.params;
            
            if (params?.count === undefined) {
                this.#parameters = [];
            } else {
                // Create parameter representatives
                this.#parameters = Array.from({ length: params.count }, (_, i) => 
                    new $FunctionParameterRep(`param${i}`, false)
                );
                if (params.rest) {
                    this.#parameters.push(new $FunctionParameterRep('rest', true));
                }
            }
        }
        return this.#parameters;
    }
}

export class $GenericFunctionRep implements $Rep {
    #function: $FunctionRep;
    #ref?: string;
    #arguments?: $TypeRep;
    #asConstructor?: $ConstructorRep;

    constructor(func: $FunctionRep) {
        this.#function = func;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `${this.#function.ref}<Generic>`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get asFunction(): $FunctionRep {
        return this.#function;
    }

    get arguments(): $TypeRep {
        if (this.#arguments === undefined) {
            // No runtime generic info available
            return undefined as any;
        }
        return this.#arguments!;
    }

    get $asConstructor(): $ConstructorRep {
        if (this.#asConstructor === undefined) {
            this.#asConstructor = this.#function.$asConstructor;
        }
        return this.#asConstructor!;
    }
}

export class $FunctionParameterRep implements $Rep {
    #name: string;
    #isRest: boolean;
    #ref?: string;
    #type?: $TypeParameterRep;

    constructor(name: string, isRest: boolean) {
        this.#name = name;
        this.#isRest = isRest;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Parameter:${this.#name}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get name(): string {
        return this.#name;
    }

    get type(): $TypeParameterRep {
        if (this.#type === undefined) {
            // No runtime type info available
            return undefined as any;
        }
        return this.#type!;
    }

    get isRest(): boolean {
        return this.#isRest;
    }
}

export class $ConstructorRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: Function;
    #ref?: string;
    #asFunction?: $FunctionRep;

    constructor(literal: Function) {
        if (typeof literal !== 'function') {
            throw new Error(`$ConstructorRep requires function, got ${typeof literal}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Constructor#${getObjectId(this.#literal)}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $asFunction(): $FunctionRep {
        if (this.#asFunction === undefined) {
            this.#asFunction = new $FunctionRep(this.#literal);
        }
        return this.#asFunction;
    }
}

export class $TypeRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: $Type;
    #ref?: string;
    #baseType?: $TypeRep;
    #prototype?: $PrototypeRep;
    #asConstructor?: $ConstructorRep;
    #parameters?: $TypeParameterRep[];
    #asGeneric?: $GenericTypeRep;
    #members?: Map<boolean, $MemberRep[]>;
    #fields?: Map<boolean, $FieldRep[]>;
    #properties?: Map<boolean, $PropertyRep[]>;
    #methods?: Map<boolean, $MethodRep[]>;

    constructor(literal: $Constructor) {
        if (typeof literal !== 'function') {
            throw new Error(`$TypeRep requires constructor, got ${typeof literal}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal;
        this.#members = new Map();
        this.#fields = new Map();
        this.#properties = new Map();
        this.#methods = new Map();
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            const name = this.#literal.name || 'Anonymous';
            const id = getObjectId(this.#literal);
            this.#ref = `Type:${name}#${id}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): $Type {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get $baseType(): $TypeRep {
        if (this.#baseType === undefined) {
            const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(this.#literal.prototype);
            if (proto === null) {
                return undefined as any;
            }
            const baseCtor = proto.constructor;
            if (baseCtor && baseCtor !== Function && baseCtor !== Object) {
                this.#baseType = new $TypeRep(baseCtor);
            } else {
                return undefined as any;
            }
        }
        return this.#baseType!;
    }

    get $prototype(): $PrototypeRep {
        if (this.#prototype === undefined) {
            this.#prototype = new $PrototypeRep(this.#literal.prototype);
        }
        return this.#prototype;
    }

    get $asConstructor(): $ConstructorRep {
        if (this.#asConstructor === undefined) {
            this.#asConstructor = new $ConstructorRep(this.#literal);
        }
        return this.#asConstructor;
    }

    get $isGeneric(): boolean {
        return this.$parameters.length > 0;
    }

    get $asGeneric(): $GenericTypeRep {
        if (this.#asGeneric === undefined) {
            if (!this.$isGeneric) return undefined as any;
            this.#asGeneric = new $GenericTypeRep(this);
        }
        return this.#asGeneric!;
    }

    get $parameters(): $TypeParameterRep[] {
        if (this.#parameters === undefined) {
            // Runtime JavaScript has no generic info - return empty array
            this.#parameters = [];
        }
        return this.#parameters;
    }

    asGenericType(...types: $GenericTypeRep[]) {
        // Runtime can't specialize generics
        return undefined as any;
    }

    $members(own: boolean = false): $MemberRep[] {
        const cached = this.#members!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result: $MemberRep[] = [];
        const seen = new Set<string>();

        // Get own descriptors from prototype
        const ownDescriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(this.#literal.prototype);
        for (const [name, desc] of Object.entries(ownDescriptors)) {
            seen.add(name);
            result.push(createMemberRep(desc, name));
        }

        // If not own-only, recurse through base types
        if (!own) {
            const baseType = this.$baseType;
            if (baseType && baseType.$literal) {
                const baseMembers = baseType.$members(false);
                for (const member of baseMembers) {
                    if (!seen.has((member as any).name)) {
                        result.push(member);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        this.#members!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $fields(own: boolean = false): $FieldRep[] {
        const cached = this.#fields!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const members = this.$members(own);
        const result = members
            .filter(m => m.$isField)
            .map(m => m.$asField!);

        this.#fields!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $properties(own: boolean = false): $PropertyRep[] {
        const cached = this.#properties!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const members = this.$members(own);
        const result = members
            .filter(m => m.$isProperty)
            .map(m => m.$asProperty!);

        this.#properties!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $methods(own: boolean = false): $MethodRep[] {
        const cached = this.#methods!.get(own);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const members = this.$members(own);
        const result = members
            .filter(m => m.$isMethod)
            .map(m => m.$asMethod!);

        this.#methods!.set(own, result);
        return result;
    }

    $getMember(name: string, own: boolean = false): $MemberRep | undefined {
        return this.$members(own).find(m => (m as any).name === name);
    }

    $getField(name: string, own: boolean = false): $FieldRep | undefined {
        return this.$fields(own).find(f => (f as any).name === name);
    }

    $getProperty(name: string, own: boolean = false): $PropertyRep | undefined {
        return this.$properties(own).find(p => (p as any).name === name);
    }

    $getMethod(name: string, own: boolean = false): $MethodRep | undefined {
        return this.$methods(own).find(m => (m as any).name === name);
    }
}

export class $GenericTypeRep implements $Rep {
    #type: $TypeRep;
    #ref?: string;
    #arguments?: $TypeRep;
    #asConstructor?: $ConstructorRep;

    constructor(type: $TypeRep) {
        this.#type = type;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `${this.#type.ref}<Generic>`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get asType(): $TypeRep {
        return this.#type;
    }

    get arguments(): $TypeRep {
        if (this.#arguments === undefined) {
            // No runtime generic info available
            return undefined as any;
        }
        return this.#arguments!;
    }

    get $asConstructor(): $ConstructorRep {
        if (this.#asConstructor === undefined) {
            this.#asConstructor = this.#type.$asConstructor;
        }
        return this.#asConstructor!;
    }
}

export class $MemberRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: PropertyDescriptor;
    #name: string;
    #ref?: string;

    constructor(literal: PropertyDescriptor, name: string) {
        this.#literal = literal;
        this.#name = name;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Member:${this.#name}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): PropertyDescriptor {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get $isField(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.value !== undefined && 
               typeof this.#literal.value !== 'function';
    }

    get $asField(): $FieldRep | undefined {
        if (!this.$isField) return undefined;
        return new $FieldRep(this.#literal, this.#name);
    }

    get $isProperty(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.get !== undefined || 
               this.#literal.set !== undefined;
    }

    get $asProperty(): $PropertyRep | undefined {
        if (!this.$isProperty) return undefined;
        return new $PropertyRep(this.#literal, this.#name);
    }

    get $isMethod(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.value !== undefined && 
               typeof this.#literal.value === 'function';
    }

    get $asMethod(): $MethodRep | undefined {
        if (!this.$isMethod) return undefined;
        return new $MethodRep(this.#literal, this.#name);
    }

    get isReadable(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.get !== undefined || 
               this.#literal.value !== undefined;
    }

    get isWritable(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.set !== undefined || 
               (this.#literal.writable === true);
    }

    get isConfigurable(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.configurable === true;
    }

    get isEnumerable(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.enumerable === true;
    }

    // Expose name for internal use
    get name(): string {
        return this.#name;
    }
}

export class $FieldRep extends $MemberRep {
    get $isField() { return true; }
    get $asField() { return this; }
}

export class $PropertyRep extends $MemberRep {
    get $isProperty() { return true; }
    get $asProperty() { return this; }
}

export class $MethodRep extends $MemberRep {
    #asFunction?: $FunctionRep;

    get $isMethod() { return true; }
    get $asMethod() { return this; }

    get $asFunction(): $FunctionRep {
        if (this.#asFunction === undefined) {
            const func = this.$literal.value as Function;
            this.#asFunction = new $FunctionRep(func);
        }
        return this.#asFunction;
    }
}

export class $TypeParameterRep implements $Rep {
    #name: string;
    #ref?: string;
    #constraint?: $TypeRep;
    #default?: $TypeRep;

    constructor(name: string) {
        this.#name = name;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `TypeParameter:${this.#name}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get constraint(): $TypeRep {
        if (this.#constraint === undefined) {
            // No runtime constraint info
            return undefined as any;
        }
        return this.#constraint!;
    }

    get default(): $TypeRep {
        if (this.#default === undefined) {
            // No runtime default info
            return undefined as any;
        }
        return this.#default!;
    }
}

// Helper function to create the appropriate member representative
function createMemberRep(desc: PropertyDescriptor, name: string): $MemberRep {
    const base = new $MemberRep(desc, name);
    
    if (base.$isField) {
        return new $FieldRep(desc, name);
    } else if (base.$isProperty) {
        return new $PropertyRep(desc, name);
    } else if (base.$isMethod) {
        return new $MethodRep(desc, name);
    }
    
    return base;
}

// Helper functions from previous implementation
export function createPrototypeChain<T>(object: object, constructor?: $Constructor<T>): object[] {
    if (constructor && !(object instanceof constructor))
        throw new Error(`[${object}] is not instanceof [${constructor?.name}]`);
    
    let prototype = object;
    const prototypes: object[] = [];
    while (prototype && prototype !== constructor?.prototype) {
        prototypes.unshift(prototype);
        prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(prototype);
    }

    return prototypes;
}

export function parseFunctionInfo(func: Function): $FunctionInfo {
    const str = func.toString();
    let name = func.name || '';
    
    const hasNativeCode = str.includes('[native code]');
    const pattern = getFunctionPattern();
    const match = pattern.exec(str);
    
    if (!match?.groups) {
        return { 
            form: 'unknown',
            name,
            async: undefined,
            generator: undefined,
            native: hasNativeCode ? true : undefined,
            params: { count: undefined, rest: undefined }
        };
    }
    
    const g = match.groups;
    const async = !!g.async || !!g.asyncArrow || !!g.async2;
    const generator = !!g.funcStar || !!g.methodStar;
    
    let form: $FunctionInfo['form'];
    if (g.arrow) {
        form = 'lambda';
        if (name && /^\d+$/.test(name)) name = '';
    }
    else if (g.class) form = 'class';
    else if (g.get) {
        form = 'getter';
        name = name.replace(/^get /, '');
    }
    else if (g.set) {
        form = 'setter';
        name = name.replace(/^set /, '');
    }
    else if (g.function) form = 'function';
    else if (g.methodName) form = 'method';
    else form = 'unknown';
    
    const paramStr = g.arrowParams || g.arrowSingle || g.params || g.params2 || '';
    
    if (!paramStr && form !== 'lambda') {
        return { form, name, async, generator, native: hasNativeCode, params: { count: 0, rest: false } };
    }
    
    if (g.arrowSingle) {
        return { form, name, async, generator, native: hasNativeCode, params: { count: 1, rest: false } };
    }
    
    const trimmed = paramStr.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
        return { form, name, async, generator, native: hasNativeCode, params: { count: 0, rest: false } };
    }
    
    const parts = trimmed.split(',').map(p => p.trim());
    const last = parts[parts.length - 1];
    const rest = last.startsWith('...');
    const count = rest ? parts.length - 1 : parts.length;
    
    return { form, name, async, generator, native: hasNativeCode, params: { count, rest } };
}

let $pattern: RegExp | undefined;
function getFunctionPattern(): RegExp {
    if ($pattern) return $pattern;
    
    const ws = '\\s+';
    const ws0 = '\\s*';
    const id = '[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*';
    const paramContent = '[^)]*';
    
    const arrowBranch = 
        `(?:` +
            `(?<asyncArrow>async${ws})?` +
            `(?:` +
                `\\((?<arrowParams>${paramContent})\\)${ws0}(?<arrow>=>)|` +
                `(?<arrowSingle>${id})${ws0}=>` +
            `)` +
        `)`;
    
    const traditionalBranch = 
        `(?:` +
            `(?<async>async${ws})?` +
            `(?:` +
                `(?<class>class)|` +
                `(?<get>get)|` +
                `(?<set>set)|` +
                `(?<function>function)${ws0}(?<funcStar>\\*)?` +
            `)${ws0}(?:${id}${ws0})?` +
            `(?:\\((?<params>${paramContent})\\))?` +
        `)`;
    
    const methodBranch = 
        `(?:` +
            `(?<async2>async${ws})?` +
            `(?<methodStar>\\*)?` +
            `(?<methodName>${id})${ws0}` +
            `\\((?<params2>${paramContent})\\)` +
        `)`;
    
    $pattern = new RegExp(
        `^(?:${arrowBranch}|${traditionalBranch}|${methodBranch})`
    );
    
    return $pattern;
}

import { $Type, $Constructor, $Rep } from "./types";
import { $lib } from './catalogue';

export interface $FunctionInfo {
    form: 'lambda' | 'function' | 'method' | 'getter' | 'setter' | 'class' | 'unknown';
    name?: string;
    async?: boolean;
    generator?: boolean;
    native?: boolean;
    params?: {
        count: number | undefined;
        rest: boolean | undefined;
    };
}

// Global WeakMap for object identity
const objectIds = new WeakMap<object, number>();
let nextObjectId = 1;

function getObjectId(obj: object): number {
    let id = objectIds.get(obj);
    if (id === undefined) {
        id = nextObjectId++;
        objectIds.set(obj, id);
    }
    return id;
}

export class $ObjectRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: object;
    #ref?: string;

    constructor(literal: object) {
        if (typeof literal !== 'object' || literal === null) {
            throw new Error(`$ObjectRep requires object, got ${typeof literal}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Object#${getObjectId(this.#literal)}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): object {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get $prototype(): $PrototypeRep {
        let cached = $lib.$find<$PrototypeRep>(this);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(this.#literal);
        const result = proto === null ? undefined : new $PrototypeRep(proto);
        $lib.$index(this, result);
        return result as any;
    }

    get asPrototype(): $PrototypeRep {
        return this.$prototype;
    }

    get $type(): $TypeRep {
        const key = new $PrimitiveRep('$type:' + this.ref);
        let cached = $lib.$find<$TypeRep>(key);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const constructor = this.#literal.constructor;
        const result = (constructor && typeof constructor === 'function') 
            ? new $TypeRep(constructor as $Constructor)
            : undefined;
        $lib.$index(key, result);
        return result as any;
    }

    $members(own: boolean = true): $MemberRep[] {
        const key = new $PrimitiveRep(`members:${this.ref}:${own}`);
        let cached = $lib.$find<$MemberRep[]>(key);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result: $MemberRep[] = [];
        const seen = new Set<string>();

        const ownDescriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(this.#literal);
        for (const [name, desc] of Object.entries(ownDescriptors)) {
            seen.add(name);
            result.push(createMemberRep(desc, name));
        }

        if (!own) {
            const proto = this.$prototype;
            if (proto && proto.$literal !== null) {
                const baseMembers = proto.$members(false);
                for (const member of baseMembers) {
                    if (!seen.has((member as any).name)) {
                        result.push(member);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $lib.$index(key, result);
        return result;
    }

    $fields(own: boolean = true): $FieldRep[] {
        return this.$members(own).filter(m => m.$isField).map(m => m.$asField!);
    }

    $properties(own: boolean = true): $PropertyRep[] {
        return this.$members(own).filter(m => m.$isProperty).map(m => m.$asProperty!);
    }

    $methods(own: boolean = true): $MethodRep[] {
        return this.$members(own).filter(m => m.$isMethod).map(m => m.$asMethod!);
    }

    $getField(name: string, own: boolean = true): $FieldRep | undefined {
        return this.$fields(own).find(f => (f as any).name === name);
    }

    $getProperty(name: string, own: boolean = true): $PropertyRep | undefined {
        return this.$properties(own).find(p => (p as any).name === name);
    }

    $getMethod(name: string, own: boolean = true): $MethodRep | undefined {
        return this.$methods(own).find(m => (m as any).name === name);
    }
}

export class $PrototypeRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: object;
    #ref?: string;

    constructor(literal: object) {
        if (typeof literal !== 'object' || literal === null) {
            throw new Error(`$PrototypeRep requires object, got ${typeof literal}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Prototype#${getObjectId(this.#literal)}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): object {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get asObject(): $ObjectRep {
        let cached = $lib.$find<$ObjectRep>(this);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result = new $ObjectRep(this.#literal);
        $lib.$index(this, result);
        return result;
    }

    $members(own: boolean = true): $MemberRep[] {
        const key = new $PrimitiveRep(`members:${this.ref}:${own}`);
        let cached = $lib.$find<$MemberRep[]>(key);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result: $MemberRep[] = [];
        const seen = new Set<string>();

        const ownDescriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(this.#literal);
        for (const [name, desc] of Object.entries(ownDescriptors)) {
            seen.add(name);
            result.push(createMemberRep(desc, name));
        }

        if (!own) {
            const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(this.#literal);
            if (proto !== null) {
                const baseProto = new $PrototypeRep(proto);
                const baseMembers = baseProto.$members(false);
                for (const member of baseMembers) {
                    if (!seen.has((member as any).name)) {
                        result.push(member);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $lib.$index(key, result);
        return result;
    }

    $fields(own: boolean = true): $FieldRep[] {
        return this.$members(own).filter(m => m.$isField).map(m => m.$asField!);
    }

    $properties(own: boolean = true): $PropertyRep[] {
        return this.$members(own).filter(m => m.$isProperty).map(m => m.$asProperty!);
    }

    $methods(own: boolean = true): $MethodRep[] {
        return this.$members(own).filter(m => m.$isMethod).map(m => m.$asMethod!);
    }

    $getField(name: string, own: boolean = true): $FieldRep | undefined {
        return this.$fields(own).find(f => (f as any).name === name);
    }

    $getProperty(name: string, own: boolean = true): $PropertyRep | undefined {
        return this.$properties(own).find(p => (p as any).name === name);
    }

    $getMethod(name: string, own: boolean = true): $MethodRep | undefined {
        return this.$methods(own).find(m => (m as any).name === name);
    }
}

export class $PrimitiveRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: any;
    #ref?: string;

    constructor(literal: any) {
        const type = typeof literal;
        if (type !== 'string' && type !== 'number' && type !== 'boolean' && 
            type !== 'undefined' && type !== 'symbol' && type !== 'bigint' && 
            literal !== null) {
            throw new Error(`$PrimitiveRep requires primitive, got ${type}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            const type = typeof this.#literal;
            if (this.#literal === null) {
                this.#ref = 'null';
            } else if (this.#literal === undefined) {
                this.#ref = 'undefined';
            } else if (type === 'symbol') {
                this.#ref = `symbol:${this.#literal.toString()}`;
            } else {
                this.#ref = `${type}:${String(this.#literal)}`;
            }
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): any {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get asObject(): $ObjectRep {
        let cached = $lib.$find<$ObjectRep>(this);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        if (this.#literal === null || this.#literal === undefined) {
            return undefined as any;
        }

        const boxed = Object(this.#literal);
        const result = new $ObjectRep(boxed);
        $lib.$index(this, result);
        return result;
    }
}

export class $FunctionRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: (...args: any[]) => any;
    #ref?: string;

    constructor(literal: Function) {
        if (typeof literal !== 'function') {
            throw new Error(`$FunctionRep requires function, got ${typeof literal}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal as any;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Function#${getObjectId(this.#literal)}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): (...args: any[]) => any {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get $asConstructor(): $ConstructorRep {
        let cached = $lib.$find<$ConstructorRep>(this);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        if (this.#literal.prototype === undefined) {
            return undefined as any;
        }

        const result = new $ConstructorRep(this.#literal);
        $lib.$index(this, result);
        return result;
    }

    get $asObject(): $ObjectRep {
        const key = new $PrimitiveRep('$asObject:' + this.ref);
        let cached = $lib.$find<$ObjectRep>(key);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result = new $ObjectRep(this.#literal);
        $lib.$index(key, result);
        return result;
    }

    get $isGeneric(): boolean {
        return this.$typeParameters.length > 0;
    }

    get $asGeneric(): $GenericFunctionRep {
        if (!this.$isGeneric) return undefined as any;
        return new $GenericFunctionRep(this);
    }

    get $typeParameters(): $TypeParameterRep[] {
        // No runtime generic info
        return [];
    }

    #getInfo(): $FunctionInfo {
        const key = new $PrimitiveRep('info:' + this.ref);
        let cached = $lib.$find<$FunctionInfo>(key);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result = parseFunctionInfo(this.#literal);
        $lib.$index(key, result);
        return result;
    }

    get form(): 'lambda' | 'function' | 'method' | 'getter' | 'setter' | 'class' | 'unknown' {
        return this.#getInfo().form;
    }

    get name(): string {
        return this.#getInfo().name || '';
    }

    get async(): boolean {
        return this.#getInfo().async || false;
    }

    get generator(): boolean {
        return this.#getInfo().generator || false;
    }

    get native(): boolean {
        return this.#getInfo().native || false;
    }

    get parameters(): $FunctionParameterRep[] {
        const key = new $PrimitiveRep('params:' + this.ref);
        let cached = $lib.$find<$FunctionParameterRep[]>(key);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const info = this.#getInfo();
        const params = info.params;
        
        if (params?.count === undefined) {
            $lib.$index(key, []);
            return [];
        }

        const result: $FunctionParameterRep[] = Array.from(
            { length: params.count }, 
            (_, i) => new $FunctionParameterRep(`param${i}`, false)
        );
        
        if (params.rest) {
            result.push(new $FunctionParameterRep('rest', true));
        }

        $lib.$index(key, result);
        return result;
    }
}

    #function: $FunctionRep;

        }

export class $ConstructorRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: Function;
    #ref?: string;

    constructor(literal: Function) {
        if (typeof literal !== 'function') {
            throw new Error(`$ConstructorRep requires function, got ${typeof literal}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Constructor#${getObjectId(this.#literal)}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $asFunction(): $FunctionRep {
        let cached = $lib.$find<$FunctionRep>(this);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result = new $FunctionRep(this.#literal);
        $lib.$index(this, result);
        return result;
    }

export class $TypeRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: $Type;
    #ref?: string;

    constructor(literal: $Constructor) {
        if (typeof literal !== 'function') {
            throw new Error(`$TypeRep requires constructor, got ${typeof literal}`);
        }
        this.#literal = literal;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            const name = this.#literal.name || 'Anonymous';
            const id = getObjectId(this.#literal);
            this.#ref = `Type:${name}#${id}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): $Type {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get $baseType(): $TypeRep {
        const key = new $PrimitiveRep('$baseType:' + this.ref);
        let cached = $lib.$find<$TypeRep>(key);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(this.#literal.prototype);
        if (proto === null) {
            return undefined as any;
        }

        const baseCtor = proto.constructor;
        if (!baseCtor || baseCtor === Function || baseCtor === Object) {
            return undefined as any;
        }

        const result = new $TypeRep(baseCtor);
        $lib.$index(key, result);
        return result;
    }

    get $prototype(): $PrototypeRep {
        let cached = $lib.$find<$PrototypeRep>(this);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result = new $PrototypeRep(this.#literal.prototype);
        $lib.$index(this, result);
        return result;
    }

    get $asConstructor(): $ConstructorRep {
        const key = new $PrimitiveRep('$asConstructor:' + this.ref);
        let cached = $lib.$find<$ConstructorRep>(key);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result = new $ConstructorRep(this.#literal);
        $lib.$index(key, result);
        return result;
    }

    get $isGeneric(): boolean {
        return this.$parameters.length > 0;
    }

    get $asGeneric(): $GenericTypeRep {
        if (!this.$isGeneric) return undefined as any;
        return new $GenericTypeRep(this);
    }

    get $parameters(): $TypeParameterRep[] {
        // No runtime generic info
        return [];
    }

    asGenericType(...types: $GenericTypeRep[]) {
        return undefined as any;
    }

    $members(own: boolean = false): $MemberRep[] {
        const key = new $PrimitiveRep(`members:${this.ref}:${own}`);
        let cached = $lib.$find<$MemberRep[]>(key);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const result: $MemberRep[] = [];
        const seen = new Set<string>();

        const ownDescriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(this.#literal.prototype);
        for (const [name, desc] of Object.entries(ownDescriptors)) {
            seen.add(name);
            result.push(createMemberRep(desc, name));
        }

        if (!own) {
            const baseType = this.$baseType;
            if (baseType && baseType.$literal) {
                const baseMembers = baseType.$members(false);
                for (const member of baseMembers) {
                    if (!seen.has((member as any).name)) {
                        result.push(member);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $lib.$index(key, result);
        return result;
    }

    $fields(own: boolean = false): $FieldRep[] {
        return this.$members(own).filter(m => m.$isField).map(m => m.$asField!);
    }

    $properties(own: boolean = false): $PropertyRep[] {
        return this.$members(own).filter(m => m.$isProperty).map(m => m.$asProperty!);
    }

    $methods(own: boolean = false): $MethodRep[] {
        return this.$members(own).filter(m => m.$isMethod).map(m => m.$asMethod!);
    }

    $getMember(name: string, own: boolean = false): $MemberRep | undefined {
        return this.$members(own).find(m => (m as any).name === name);
    }

    $getField(name: string, own: boolean = false): $FieldRep | undefined {
        return this.$fields(own).find(f => (f as any).name === name);
    }

    $getProperty(name: string, own: boolean = false): $PropertyRep | undefined {
        return this.$properties(own).find(p => (p as any).name === name);
    }

    $getMethod(name: string, own: boolean = false): $MethodRep | undefined {
        return this.$methods(own).find(m => (m as any).name === name);
    }
}

            this.#ref = `${this.#type.ref}<Generic>`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    }

export class $MemberRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: PropertyDescriptor;
    #name: string;
    #ref?: string;

    constructor(literal: PropertyDescriptor, name: string) {
        this.#literal = literal;
        this.#name = name;
    }

    get ref(): string {
        if (this.#ref === undefined) {
            this.#ref = `Member:${this.#name}`;
        }
        return this.#ref;
    }

    get $literal(): PropertyDescriptor {
        return this.#literal;
    }

    get $isField(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.value !== undefined && 
               typeof this.#literal.value !== 'function';
    }

    get $asField(): $FieldRep | undefined {
        if (!this.$isField) return undefined;
        return new $FieldRep(this.#literal, this.#name);
    }

    get $isProperty(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.get !== undefined || 
               this.#literal.set !== undefined;
    }

    get $asProperty(): $PropertyRep | undefined {
        if (!this.$isProperty) return undefined;
        return new $PropertyRep(this.#literal, this.#name);
    }

    get $isMethod(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.value !== undefined && 
               typeof this.#literal.value === 'function';
    }

    get $asMethod(): $MethodRep | undefined {
        if (!this.$isMethod) return undefined;
        return new $MethodRep(this.#literal, this.#name);
    }

    get isReadable(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.get !== undefined || 
               this.#literal.value !== undefined;
    }

    get isWritable(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.set !== undefined || 
               (this.#literal.writable === true);
    }

    get isConfigurable(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.configurable === true;
    }

    get isEnumerable(): boolean {
        return this.#literal.enumerable === true;
    }

    get name(): string {
        return this.#name;
    }
}

export class $FieldRep extends $MemberRep {
    get $isField() { return true; }
    get $asField() { return this; }
}

export class $PropertyRep extends $MemberRep {
    get $isProperty() { return true; }
    get $asProperty() { return this; }
}

export class $MethodRep extends $MemberRep {
    get $isMethod() { return true; }
    get $asMethod() { return this; }

    get $asFunction(): $FunctionRep {
        let cached = $lib.$find<$FunctionRep>(this);
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached;

        const func = this.$literal.value as Function;
        const result = new $FunctionRep(func);
        $lib.$index(this, result);
        return result;
    }
}

            this.#ref = `TypeParameter:${this.#name}`;
        }

    }

        return undefined as any;
    }

function createMemberRep(desc: PropertyDescriptor, name: string): $MemberRep {
    const base = new $MemberRep(desc, name);
    
    if (base.$isField) {
        return new $FieldRep(desc, name);
    } else if (base.$isProperty) {
        return new $PropertyRep(desc, name);
    } else if (base.$isMethod) {
        return new $MethodRep(desc, name);
    }
    
    return base;
}

export function parseFunctionInfo(func: Function): $FunctionInfo {
    const str = func.toString();
    let name = func.name || '';
    
    const hasNativeCode = str.includes('[native code]');
    const pattern = getFunctionPattern();
    const match = pattern.exec(str);
    
    if (!match?.groups) {
        return { 
            form: 'unknown',
            name,
            async: undefined,
            generator: undefined,
            native: hasNativeCode ? true : undefined,
            params: { count: undefined, rest: undefined }
        };
    }
    
    const g = match.groups;
    const async = !!g.async || !!g.asyncArrow || !!g.async2;
    const generator = !!g.funcStar || !!g.methodStar;
    
    let form: $FunctionInfo['form'];
    if (g.arrow) {
        form = 'lambda';
        if (name && /^\d+$/.test(name)) name = '';
    }
    else if (g.class) form = 'class';
    else if (g.get) {
        form = 'getter';
        name = name.replace(/^get /, '');
    }
    else if (g.set) {
        form = 'setter';
        name = name.replace(/^set /, '');
    }
    else if (g.function) form = 'function';
    else if (g.methodName) form = 'method';
    else form = 'unknown';
    
    const paramStr = g.arrowParams || g.arrowSingle || g.params || g.params2 || '';
    
    if (!paramStr && form !== 'lambda') {
        return { form, name, async, generator, native: hasNativeCode, params: { count: 0, rest: false } };
    }
    
    if (g.arrowSingle) {
        return { form, name, async, generator, native: hasNativeCode, params: { count: 1, rest: false } };
    }
    
    const trimmed = paramStr.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
        return { form, name, async, generator, native: hasNativeCode, params: { count: 0, rest: false } };
    }
    
    const parts = trimmed.split(',').map(p => p.trim());
    const last = parts[parts.length - 1];
    const rest = last.startsWith('...');
    const count = rest ? parts.length - 1 : parts.length;
    
    return { form, name, async, generator, native: hasNativeCode, params: { count, rest } };
}

let $pattern: RegExp | undefined;
function getFunctionPattern(): RegExp {
    if ($pattern) return $pattern;
    
    const ws = '\\s+';
    const ws0 = '\\s*';
    const id = '[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*';
    const paramContent = '[^)]*';
    
    const arrowBranch = 
        `(?:` +
            `(?<asyncArrow>async${ws})?` +
            `(?:` +
                `\\((?<arrowParams>${paramContent})\\)${ws0}(?<arrow>=>)|` +
                `(?<arrowSingle>${id})${ws0}=>` +
            `)` +
        `)`;
    
    const traditionalBranch = 
        `(?:` +
            `(?<async>async${ws})?` +
            `(?:` +
                `(?<class>class)|` +
                `(?<get>get)|` +
                `(?<set>set)|` +
                `(?<function>function)${ws0}(?<funcStar>\\*)?` +
            `)${ws0}(?:${id}${ws0})?` +
            `(?:\\((?<params>${paramContent})\\))?` +
        `)`;
    
    const methodBranch = 
        `(?:` +
            `(?<async2>async${ws})?` +
            `(?<methodStar>\\*)?` +
            `(?<methodName>${id})${ws0}` +
            `\\((?<params2>${paramContent})\\)` +
        `)`;
    
    $pattern = new RegExp(
        `^(?:${arrowBranch}|${traditionalBranch}|${methodBranch})`
    );
    
    return $pattern;
}

Let me think through the information flow first:
Information Flow Analysis
$TypeRep - The Type Authority:
Stores: the constructor function
Ref from: constructor name + object identity
$baseType from: walking prototype chain of constructor.prototype
$prototype from: constructor.prototype itself
Members from: Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(constructor.prototype) - this is where member data originates
The TYPE knows its members because it can inspect its prototype
$ObjectRep - The Instance Authority:
Stores: the object instance
Ref from: object identity via WeakMap
$type from: instance.constructor → wraps in $TypeRep
$prototype from: Object.getPrototypeOf(instance) → wraps in $PrototypeRep
Members from: Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(instance) - instance-level members (fields)
The INSTANCE knows its own fields because it can inspect itself
$PrototypeRep - The Prototype Authority:
Stores: a prototype object
Essentially same as $ObjectRep but semantic distinction
Members from: Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(prototype) - the prototype chain
$MemberRep - The Descriptor Holder:
Stores: PropertyDescriptor + name (+ potentially declaringType for metadata)
Ref from: member name (+ declaring type context if available)
The descriptor is given to it during enumeration - it doesn't fetch it
Question: Should it store a reference to its declaring type for completeness?
$FunctionRep - The Function Analyzer:
Stores: the function itself
Ref from: function identity via WeakMap
Info (form, async, etc) from: parseFunctionInfo(function.toString())
Parameters from: parsing the function signature
$asConstructor from: checking function.prototype existence
$asObject from: treating function as an object
$ConstructorRep - The Construction View:
Stores: constructor function
Just a semantic wrapper around a function viewed as constructor
$asFunction converts back to $FunctionRep
$PrimitiveRep - The Primitive Holder:
Stores: primitive value
Ref from: type + stringified value
asObject from: Object(value) to box the primitive
Key Insights:
Members are created during enumeration - TypeRep/ObjectRep/PrototypeRep enumerate their descriptors and create MemberReps with (descriptor, name) pairs
Members should probably know their declaring type - for completeness and C#-like reflection
No symbols needed - since everything is lazily initialized in private fields
Types and Objects are dual authorities - Types know class-level members, Objects know instance-level fields
Reference generation is identity-based - WeakMap for objects/functions, computed string for primitives

    };

let nextObjectId = 1;

export class $ObjectRep implements $Rep {
    #literal: object;

    #prototype?: $PrototypeRep;
    #type?: $TypeRep;

    $members(own: boolean = true): $MemberRep[] { throw ''; }

        return this.$members(own).filter(m => m.$isMethod).map(m => m.$asMethod!);

        return this.$members(own).find(m => m.name === name);

    $getField(name: string, own: boolean = false): $FieldRep | undefined {

    }
    $getProperty(name: string, own: boolean = false): $PropertyRep | undefined { 
        return this.$properties(own).find(p => p.name === name);
    }
    $getMethod(name: string, own: boolean = false): $MethodRep | undefined { 
        return this.$methods(own).find(m => m.name === name);
    }
}
